findings.evidence: Best fitness rose 0.5971 -> 2.8315 (~4.7x) via INGA; WNGA 0.9770 independently corroborates position-39 levers.
EXPLOIT_MODEL 2/4 picks and LOCAL_MUTATE 1/6 produced the improvements; EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN 0/8 and EXPLORE_DIVERSE 0/6 produced none (14 of 24 slots).
New-point prediction RMSE was not logged this round, so surrogate generalization change is undeterminable; CV RMSE 0.434, Spearman 0.533 at n=48.
INGA 2.8315 is a single unreplicated measurement; magnitude must be confirmed by direct replication or neighbor evidence before being treated as a true optimum.
Local search is narrow rather than stuck: CNSA 0.9936 (G41->S) is a strong neighbor but five of six fell below parent 0.5971.
Exploitation and local pools both concentrated on the CNGA/INGA parent family (X-N-G-A) this round; next round should not only re-parent onto INGA but retain an informed diversity guard.
Leakage inputs restricted to observed measurements and proposal metadata; surrogate trained on 48 observed points only; GWHC UNAVAILABLE rejection refilled within budget.

hypothesis_updates.reason: INGA 2.8315 is a single unreplicated measurement and must be replicated before being treated as a true optimum.
Two of four position-39 substitutions (W, I) beat the previous best, corroborating position 39 as a dominant fitness lever and justifying the L/M/F/V/Y/S/T/A extension.
N at position 40 appears in all top variants (CNGA, WNGA, INGA, CNSA), consistent with N40 being required context for high fitness.
Uncertainty picks in the low-yield region (KNAA 0.3322, seven others <= 0.0449) confirm a low plateau that should receive minimal sampling next round.
CNSA (G41->S) reached 0.9936, the second-best observed value, but five of six neighbors fell below the 0.5971 parent, indicating a narrow ridge worth probing around the new parent.

recommended_change: Cut EXPLORE_UNCERTAIN from 8 to ~4 slots and EXPLORE_DIVERSE from 6 to ~2 slots, reallocating ~8 slots to a replication/neighborhood block around INGA (INSA, INGV, LNGA, MNGA, FNGA) plus continuation of the position-39 NGA sweep (L/M/F/V/Y/S/T/A).

Require direct replication of INGA in round 3 before any claim of a new optimum, given it is an unreplicated single measurement; if replication slots are unavailable due to pool constraints, neighbor confirmation is the minimum.
Keep EXPLOIT_MODEL as the primary driver but constrain its candidate set to parent-lattice variants around INGA/CNGA so model picks remain interpretable.
Retain a small uncertainty arm (~4 slots) strictly as a monitoring function and demand coverage or calibration evidence, since round 2 demonstrated no decision-relevant information from it.
Mandate per-round new-point RMSE logging for round 3, as round 2 could not establish whether surrogate prediction error improved or deteriorated on freshly measured points.
